rules.encoder_training: A declared train row is encoder_seen because model training used author-provided Cell Ontology labels and expression.
rules.reference_only: A source found only in the full search reference is reference_only. Reference-free common embedding runs remain valid; native kNN/index runs must declare the reference corpus separately.
rules.sealed_timing: A source first public after the finalized v1.1 record is target_label_unexposed for the sealed source and clean_declared for development sources unless another declaration names it.
